-- CONSTANTE --

_DEBUG = false
_CAMERA_DEFAULT_ZOOM_SPEED_FACTOR = 2.1
_CAMERA_DEFAULT_MOVE_SPEED_FACTOR = 2.1



-- VARIABLE GLOBALE --

world_particles = {}
bubbles = {}
compasses = {}
invoke_tasks = {}
interval_tasks = {}
actors = {}

-- FONCTION LUA --
function tContains(tab, val)
	for index, value in ipairs(tab) do
		if isEqual(value, val) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- FONCTION TASK -- Enregistre/Interromp un évènement delayé
function invoke_custom(delay, count, funcName, ...)
	local taskId = invoke(delay, count, funcName, unpack(arg))
	table.insert(invoke_tasks, taskId)
end

function clearInvokeTasks()
	local str = ""
	for i = #invoke_tasks, 1, -1 do
		str = str .. toString(invoke_tasks[i]) .. ";"
		interrupt(invoke_tasks[i])
		desinvoke(invoke_tasks[i])
	end

	invoke_tasks = {}

	if (_DEBUG and str ~= "") then trace("clearInvokeTasks", str) end
end

-- FONCTION TASK -- Enregistre/Interromp un évènement exécuté immédiatement puis répeté toutes les X secondes
function setInterval_custom(delay, funcName, ...)

	invoke_custom(0, 1, funcName, unpack(arg))

	local taskId = setInterval(delay, funcName, unpack(arg))
	table.insert(interval_tasks, taskId)
end

function clearIntervalTasks()
	local str = ""
	for i = #interval_tasks, 1, -1 do
		str = str .. toString(interval_tasks[i]) .. ";"
		interrupt(interval_tasks[i])
		desinvoke(interval_tasks[i])
	end

	interval_tasks = {}

	if (_DEBUG and str ~= "") then trace("clearIntervalTasks", str) end
end

-- FONCTION WORLD -- Ajoute/Retire une Particle sur une cible ou une cellule du monde
function setWorldParticleCell(particleFileId, x, y, z, ...)
	local particleId = Particle.addParticleSystem(particleFileId, x, y, z, unpack(arg))
	table.insert(world_particles, particleId)

	return particleId
end

function setWorldParticleTarget(particleFileId, targetId, ...)
	local particleId = Particle.addParticleSystemToTargetWithOffset(particleFileId, targetId, unpack(arg))
	table.insert(world_particles, particleId)

	return particleId
end

function clearWorldParticles()
	local str = ""
	for i = #world_particles, 1, -1 do
		str = str .. toString(world_particles[i]) .. ";"
		Particle.removeParticleSystem(world_particles[i])
	end

	world_particles = {}

	if (_DEBUG and str ~= "") then trace("clearWorldParticles", str) end
end

-- FONCTION WORLD -- Ajoute/Retire une boussolle sur une cellule du monde
function setCompass(x, y, z)
	local compassId = UI.addCompass("compass", x, y, z)
	table.insert(compasses, compassId)

	return compassId
end

function clearCompasses()
	local str = ""
	for i = #compasses, 1, -1 do
		str = str .. toString(compasses[i]) .. ";"
		UI.removeCompass(compasses[i])
	end

	compasses = {}

	if (_DEBUG and str ~= "") then trace("clearCompasses", str) end
end

-- FONCTION WORLD -- Ajoute/Retire un actor sur une cellule du monde

function createActor(spriteName, worldX, worldY, worldZ, availableDirection, direction, height, copyMobileId)
	local mobileId = Mobile.generateClientMobileId()
	local gfxId = spriteName
	local canCopy = copyMobileId and Mobile.isMobile(copyMobileId)
	if (canCopy) then
		gfxId = Mobile.getMobileGFX(copyMobileId)
	end

	Actor.createActor(mobileId, gfxId, worldX, worldY, worldZ, availableDirection)
	if (direction) then Mobile.setMobileDirection(mobileId, direction) end
	if (height) then Actor.setActorHeight(mobileId, height) end
	if (canCopy) then
		Actor.copyActorFrom( copyMobileId, mobileId)
	end
	table.insert(actors, mobileId)

	return mobileId
end
function clearActors()
	local str = ""
	for i = #actors, 1, -1 do
		str = str .. toString(actors[i]) .. ";"
		Actor.deleteActor(actors[i])
	end

	actors = {}

	if (_DEBUG and str ~= "") then trace("clearActors", str) end
end

-- FONCTION WORLD -- Ajoute/Retire une bulle de dialogue à un mobile
function bubble(mobileId, text, offsetX, offsetY, infiniteDuration, funcOnEnd, ...)
	BubbleText.closeBubbleAttachedTo(mobileId)

	if isLower(mobileId, 0) then
		BubbleText.setCharacterSpeak(mobileId, text)
	else
		if (not offsetY) then
			local height = Mobile.getMobileHeight(mobileId)
			if (not height) then height = 6 end

			offsetY = height * 10
		end

		if (not offsetX) then offsetX = 0 end
		if (not infiniteDuration) then infiniteDuration = false end

		BubbleText.showText(mobileId, text, offsetX, offsetY, infiniteDuration, funcOnEnd, unpack(arg))
		UI.writeLocalisedInChat(text)
	end

	if (not tContains(bubbles, mobileId)) then
		table.insert(bubbles, mobileId)
	end
end

function clearBubbles(mobileId)
	local str = ""
	for i = #bubbles, 1, -1 do
		if (not mobileId) then
			str = str .. toString(bubbles[i]) .. ";"
			BubbleText.closeBubbleAttachedTo(bubbles[i])
		elseif (mobileId ~= nil and isEqual(bubbles[i], mobileId)) then
			str = str .. toString(bubbles[i]) .. ";"
			BubbleText.closeBubbleAttachedTo(bubbles[i])
			table.remove(bubbles, i)
		end
	end

	if (not mobileId) then bubbles = {} end

	if (_DEBUG and str ~= "") then trace("clearBubbles", str) end
end

-- FONCTION CINEMATIQUE -- Démarre un contexte de cinématique
function startCinematicContext(zoomFactor, cameraMobileId, musicId)
	if (_DEBUG) then trace("startCinematicContext", zoomFactor, cameraMobileId, musicId) end

    FightEvent.addFighterJoinFightCallback(Context.getLeaderId(), "skipCinematic")

	UI.manageFrame("World", false)
	UI.setShortcutEnabled(false)
	UI.setShortcutUsable(false)
	UI.closeMRU()
	UI.closeAllBags()
	UI.setUIVisible(false)
	UI.displayWideScreenBand(true)
	Camera.setUserZoomLocked(true)
	UI.setToastsEnabled(false)
	
    Actor.forceDismount(Context.getLeaderId())

	if (cameraMobileId ~= nil) then
		Camera.setMoveSpeedFactor(10000)
		Camera.attachCameraToMobile(cameraMobileId, "Camera.setMoveSpeedFactor", _CAMERA_DEFAULT_MOVE_SPEED_FACTOR)
	end

	if (zoomFactor ~= nil) then
		Camera.setZoomFactor(zoomFactor)
	end

	if (musicId ~= nil) then
		Sound.playForcedMusic(musicId)
	end

	if (_DEBUG) then UI.displayButton(true, "scenario.endKinematic.confirmEscape", "scenario.endKinematic", "skipCinematic") end
end

-- FONCTION CINEMATIQUE -- Termine un contexte de cinématique
function stopCinematicContext(zoomFactor, cameraMobileId, stopMusic)
	if (_DEBUG) then trace("stopCinematicContext", zoomFactor, cameraMobileId, stopMusic) end

	UI.manageFrame("World", true)
	UI.setShortcutEnabled(true)
	UI.setShortcutUsable(true)
	UI.displayWideScreenBand(false)
	UI.setUIVisible(true)
	Camera.setUserZoomLocked(false)

	Camera.setZoomSpeedFactor(_CAMERA_DEFAULT_ZOOM_SPEED_FACTOR)
	Camera.setMoveSpeedFactor(_CAMERA_DEFAULT_MOVE_SPEED_FACTOR)

	if (zoomFactor ~= nil) then Camera.setZoomFactor(zoomFactor) end

	if (cameraMobileId ~= nil) then Camera.attachCameraToMobile(cameraMobileId) end

	if (fullScreenId ~= nil) then Effect.stopEffect(fullScreenId) end

	if (textId ~= nil) then Effect.stopEffect(textId) end

	if (stopMusic) then Sound.stopForcedMusic() end

	Mobile.setMobileVisible(Context.getLeaderId(), true)

	FightEvent.removeCallback(Context.getLeaderId(), "FIGHTER_JOIN_FIGHT")

	--TRIGGER
	Server.triggerEvent(2)
end

-- FONCTION CINEMATIQUE --
function skipCinematic(eventId)
	if (_DEBUG) then trace("skipCinematic", eventId) end
	local playerId = Context.getLeaderId()
	Mobile.setMobileAnimation(playerId, "AnimStatique")
    Actor.restoreMountStatus(playerId)
    Mobile.hideOtherPlayerMobile(false)

	clearCinematic()
	stopCinematicContext(1, Context.getLeaderId(), true)

	--TRIGGER
	if (eventId ~= nil) then Server.triggerEvent(eventId) end
end

-- FONCTION CINEMATIQUE -- Permet de nettoyer les éléments utilisés durant une cinématique --
function clearCinematic()
	if (_DEBUG) then trace("clearCinematic") end

	if clearIntervalTasks then clearIntervalTasks() end
	if clearInvokeTasks then clearInvokeTasks() end
	if clearBubbles then clearBubbles() end
	if clearWorldParticles then clearWorldParticles() end
	if clearCompasses then clearCompasses() end
	if clearActors then clearActors() end

	Focus.display(false)
	UI.hideButton()
	UI.unloadTutorialDialog()
	UI.setToastsEnabled(true)
end

-- FONCTION VIDEO -- Démarre un contexte de vidéo
function startVideoContext()
	if (_DEBUG) then trace("startVideoContext") end

    if (Video.videoAvailable()) then
        UI.manageFrame("World", false)
        UI.closeMRU()
        UI.closeAllBags()
        UI.setUIVisible(false)
        UI.setShortcutUsable(false)
        UI.setShortcutEnabled(false)
        Camera.setUserZoomLocked(true)
	end
end

-- FONCTION VIDEO -- Termine un contexte de vidéo
function stopVideoContext()
	if (_DEBUG) then trace("stopVideoContext") end

    if (Video.videoAvailable()) then
        UI.manageFrame("World", true)
        UI.setUIVisible(true)
        UI.setShortcutUsable(true)
        UI.setShortcutEnabled(true)
        Camera.setUserZoomLocked(false)
	end

    Mobile.setMobileVisible(Context.getLeaderId(), true)

	--TRIGGER
	Server.triggerEvent(4)
end

-- FONCTION VIDEO --
function skipVideo(eventId)
	if (_DEBUG) then trace("skipVideo", eventId) end

	clearVideo()
	stopVideoContext()

	--TRIGGER
	if (eventId ~= nil) then Server.triggerEvent(eventId) end
end

-- FONCTION VIDEO -- Permet de nettoyer les éléments utilisés durant une vidéo --
function clearVideo()
	if (_DEBUG) then trace("clearVideo") end
end

-- FONCTION TEXTE NARRATEUR - Permet d'afficher des textes de narration en plein écran
function fullScreen(fadein, duration, fadeout)
	fullScreenId = Effect.createFullScreenSprite(fadein, duration, fadeout, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
end

function text(fadein, duration, fadeout, translationKey)
	textId = UI.createFullScreenText(fadein, duration, fadeout, translationKey, 0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1.0, "bagnard", 40, 4)
end

-- [EVENT] Le joueur se fait assaillir par les pirates - Cinématique
-- 
function event_2515_22110()
    local playerId = Context.getLeaderId()
    local pirateA = createActor(1109805374, -43, 114, -51, 8, 3, 8)
    local pirateB = createActor(1109805373, -42, 114, -51, 8, 3, 8)
    local pirateC = createActor(1109805375, -41, 114, -51, 8, 3, 8)
    
    startCinematicContext(1.2, playerId)
    UI.displayButton(true, "scenario.endKinematic.confirmEscape", "scenario.endKinematic", "skipCinematic", 22110)
    
    -- "J'ai les informations qu'il me faut, je vais retourner voir Nao pour lui donner des nouvelles"
    invoke_custom(02000, 1, "bubble", playerId, "quest.ereboria.zone.01.05")
    invoke_custom(02000, 1, "Mobile.setMobileAnimation", playerId, "AnimEmote-Bailler")
    invoke_custom(05500, 1, "clearBubbles", playerId)
    invoke_custom(07000, 1, "Mobile.moveMobile", playerId, -36, 128, -51)
    invoke_custom(07000, 1, "Mobile.moveMobile", playerId, -42, 126, -51, "Mobile.setMobileDirection", playerId, 7)
    invoke_custom(07000, 1, "Mobile.moveMobile", pirateA, -43, 120, -51, "Mobile.setMobileDirection", playerId, 3)
    invoke_custom(07000, 1, "Mobile.moveMobile", pirateB, -42, 120, -51, "Mobile.setMobileDirection", playerId, 3)
    invoke_custom(07000, 1, "Mobile.moveMobile", pirateC, -41, 120, -51, "Mobile.setMobileDirection", playerId, 3)
    
    -- "Bonjour ! Je me suis perdu et je voudrais retrouver le chemin vers le bateau."
    invoke_custom(12000, 1, "bubble", playerId, "quest.ereboria.zone.01.06")
    invoke_custom(12000, 1, "Mobile.setMobileAnimation", playerId, "AnimEmote-Effrayee")
    invoke_custom(13000, 1, "clearBubbles", playerId)
    
    -- "Ton jeu ne marche pas avec nous. Emparez-vous de lui !"
    invoke_custom(13500, 1, "bubble", pirateA, "quest.ereboria.zone.01.07")
    invoke_custom(13500, 1, "Mobile.setMobileAnimation", pirateA, "AnimSort-1")
    invoke_custom(15000, 1, "clearBubbles", pirateA)
    
    invoke_custom(16000, 1, "skipCinematic", 22110)
end
